extends RefCounted
class_name TunisianVehicleTreatment

static func apply(vehicle_id: String, visual_root: Node3D) -> void:
    if visual_root == null:
        return

    var data := VehicleVisualCatalog.definition(vehicle_id)
    var size: Vector3 = data.get("fallback_size", Vector3(2.0, 1.2, 4.4))

    match vehicle_id:
        "taxi_01":
            _apply_taxi(visual_root, size)
        "louage_01":
            _apply_louage(visual_root, size)
        "pickup_404":
            _apply_bachee(visual_root, size)
        "pickup_01":
            _apply_pickup(visual_root, size)

static func _apply_taxi(root: Node3D, size: Vector3) -> void:
    _box(root, "TaxiRoofSign", Vector3(0, size.y * 1.55, -size.z * 0.04),
        Vector3(0.72, 0.20, 0.24), Color("#f0e4be"))
    _box(root, "TaxiBlackBumper", Vector3(0, 0.42, -size.z * 0.51),
        Vector3(size.x * 0.86, 0.16, 0.15), Color("#1f2021"))

static func _apply_louage(root: Node3D, size: Vector3) -> void:
    var stripe := Color("#b9272e")
    var stripe_height := 0.18
    _box(root, "LouageStripeLeft", Vector3(-size.x * 0.505, size.y * 0.72, 0),
        Vector3(0.035, stripe_height, size.z * 0.82), stripe)
    _box(root, "LouageStripeRight", Vector3(size.x * 0.505, size.y * 0.72, 0),
        Vector3(0.035, stripe_height, size.z * 0.82), stripe)
    _box(root, "LouageRoutePlacard", Vector3(0, size.y * 1.47, -size.z * 0.15),
        Vector3(0.86, 0.22, 0.18), Color("#f1f0e7"))

static func _apply_bachee(root: Node3D, size: Vector3) -> void:
    var canopy := _box(
        root,
        "BacheeCanvas",
        Vector3(0, size.y * 1.10, size.z * 0.24),
        Vector3(size.x * 0.88, size.y * 0.80, size.z * 0.43),
        Color("#69725d")
    )
    var canopy_material := canopy.material_override as StandardMaterial3D
    if canopy_material != null:
        canopy_material.roughness = 1.0

static func _apply_pickup(root: Node3D, size: Vector3) -> void:
    _box(root, "PickupBedRailLeft", Vector3(-size.x * 0.46, size.y * 0.92, size.z * 0.26),
        Vector3(0.06, 0.42, size.z * 0.40), Color("#c6c5bf"))
    _box(root, "PickupBedRailRight", Vector3(size.x * 0.46, size.y * 0.92, size.z * 0.26),
        Vector3(0.06, 0.42, size.z * 0.40), Color("#c6c5bf"))

static func _box(parent: Node3D, name: String, pos: Vector3, size: Vector3, color: Color) -> MeshInstance3D:
    var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
    mi.name = name
    var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
    mesh.size = size
    mi.mesh = mesh
    mi.position = pos
    var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
    mat.albedo_color = color
    mat.roughness = 0.78
    mi.material_override = mat
    parent.add_child(mi)
    return mi

extends RefCounted
class_name VehicleVisualFactory

static var _normalizer := VehicleModelNormalizer.new()

static func build(vehicle_id: String) -> Node3D:
    var data := VehicleVisualCatalog.definition(vehicle_id)
    var asset_path := VehicleVisualCatalog.resolve_scene_path(vehicle_id)
    if not asset_path.is_empty():
        var resource = load(asset_path)
        var scene: Node3D = null
        if resource is PackedScene:
            var instance = resource.instantiate()
            if instance is Node3D:
                scene = instance
        elif resource is Mesh:
            var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
            mesh_instance.mesh = resource
            scene = mesh_instance
        if scene != null:
            scene.name = "LicensedVehicleVisual"
            scene.scale = data.get("visual_scale", Vector3.ONE)
            scene.rotation_degrees = data.get("visual_rotation_deg", Vector3.ZERO)
            var target_size: Vector3 = data.get("fallback_size", Vector3(2.0, 1.2, 4.4))
            var normalized := _normalizer.normalize_to_target(scene, target_size)
            if bool(normalized.get("ok", false)):
                TunisianVehicleTreatment.apply(vehicle_id, scene)
                return scene
    var fallback := _fallback(data)
    TunisianVehicleTreatment.apply(vehicle_id, fallback)
    return fallback

static func _fallback(data: Dictionary) -> Node3D:
    var root := Node3D.new()
    root.name = "FallbackVehicleVisual"
    var size: Vector3 = data.get("fallback_size", Vector3(2.0, 1.2, 4.4))
    var color: Color = data.get("fallback_color", Color("#d7d5cf"))

    var body := MeshInstance3D.new()
    var box := BoxMesh.new()
    box.size = size
    body.mesh = box
    body.position.y = size.y * 0.58
    body.material_override = _mat(color)
    root.add_child(body)

    var cabin := MeshInstance3D.new()
    var cabin_box := BoxMesh.new()
    cabin_box.size = Vector3(size.x * 0.78, size.y * 0.72, size.z * 0.52)
    cabin.mesh = cabin_box
    cabin.position = Vector3(0, size.y * 1.18, -size.z * 0.04)
    cabin.material_override = _mat(Color("#394c59"), 0.38, 0.05)
    root.add_child(cabin)

    _add_bumper(root, Vector3(0, 0.38, -size.z * 0.52), Vector3(size.x * 0.88, 0.15, 0.14))
    _add_bumper(root, Vector3(0, 0.38, size.z * 0.52), Vector3(size.x * 0.88, 0.15, 0.14))

    var wheel_x := size.x * 0.48
    var wheel_z := size.z * 0.31
    _add_wheel(root, Vector3(-wheel_x, 0.33, -wheel_z))
    _add_wheel(root, Vector3(wheel_x, 0.33, -wheel_z))
    _add_wheel(root, Vector3(-wheel_x, 0.33, wheel_z))
    _add_wheel(root, Vector3(wheel_x, 0.33, wheel_z))

    _add_light(root, Vector3(-size.x * 0.29, 0.67, -size.z * 0.505), Color("#fff2bb"))
    _add_light(root, Vector3(size.x * 0.29, 0.67, -size.z * 0.505), Color("#fff2bb"))
    _add_light(root, Vector3(-size.x * 0.29, 0.67, size.z * 0.505), Color("#b32227"))
    _add_light(root, Vector3(size.x * 0.29, 0.67, size.z * 0.505), Color("#b32227"))
    return root

static func _add_wheel(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3) -> void:
    var wheel := MeshInstance3D.new()
    var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
    mesh.top_radius = 0.36
    mesh.bottom_radius = 0.36
    mesh.height = 0.20
    wheel.mesh = mesh
    wheel.position = pos
    wheel.rotation_degrees.z = 90.0
    wheel.material_override = _mat(Color("#18191a"), 0.94, 0.0)
    parent.add_child(wheel)

static func _add_bumper(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3, size: Vector3) -> void:
    var bumper := MeshInstance3D.new()
    var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
    mesh.size = size
    bumper.mesh = mesh
    bumper.position = pos
    bumper.material_override = _mat(Color("#303235"), 0.74, 0.08)
    parent.add_child(bumper)

static func _add_light(parent: Node3D, pos: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
    var light := MeshInstance3D.new()
    var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
    mesh.size = Vector3(0.28, 0.18, 0.06)
    light.mesh = mesh
    light.position = pos
    var mat := _mat(color, 0.32, 0.0)
    mat.emission_enabled = true
    mat.emission = color
    mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.45
    light.material_override = mat
    parent.add_child(light)

static func _mat(
    color: Color,
    roughness: float = 0.75,
    metallic: float = 0.0
) -> StandardMaterial3D:
    var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
    m.albedo_color = color
    m.roughness = roughness
    m.metallic = metallic
    return m

extends RefCounted
class_name TunisMaterialLibrary

const PLASTER_SHADER := preload("res://shaders/tunis_plaster.gdshader")
const ASPHALT_SHADER := preload("res://shaders/tunis_asphalt.gdshader")

static func plaster(color: Color) -> ShaderMaterial:
    var material := ShaderMaterial.new()
    material.shader = PLASTER_SHADER
    material.set_shader_parameter("base_color", color)
    material.set_shader_parameter("dirt_strength", 0.15)
    return material

static func asphalt() -> ShaderMaterial:
    var material := ShaderMaterial.new()
    material.shader = ASPHALT_SHADER
    return material

static func metal(color: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
    var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
    material.albedo_color = color
    material.roughness = 0.58
    material.metallic = 0.22
    return material

static func glass_tinted() -> StandardMaterial3D:
    var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
    material.albedo_color = Color(0.14,0.23,0.28,0.68)
    material.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
    material.roughness = 0.18
    material.metallic = 0.06
    return material
